name: 豪沃德·弗洛里
bio_short: 澳大利亚药理学家和病理学家，1945年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主。他领导牛津大学团队成功提取并纯化了青霉素，将其从实验室发现转化为可大规模生产的救命药物（`florey_chain_penicillin_1941`）。
bio_short_en: An Australian pharmacologist and pathologist, and a 1945 Nobel laureate. He led the Oxford team that successfully extracted and purified penicillin, transforming it from a laboratory discovery into a mass-produced life-saving drug (`florey_chain_penicillin_1941`).
